alate: The tergites of the head, thorax and abdomen are dark brown, the ventral surface of the head and of the abdomen brownish yellow, the posterior half of the labrum pale orange and the anterior half orange-red. The ocelli are far from the compound eyes, the distance between them distinctly greater than the length of the ocellus itself. The wings are rather short.
biology: It lives in the soil; the nest is entirely subterranean and consists of many fungus gardens and fungus-garden chambers. The host plants are the rubber tree, lychee and tung tree.
distribution: Fujian; Longzhou and Pingyangjiang in Pubei, Guangxi; Hekou (90 m a.s.l.), Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.), Menghai in Banna, Changpotou in Jinping (1,100 m a.s.l.), Mojiang (1,400 m a.s.l.), Pu'er (1,350 m a.s.l.), Simao, Kaiyuan, Yanshan, Lianghe and Yingjiang, Yunnan; Hepu, Haikang and Xuwen, Guangdong; Nada, Lehui, Qiongdong and Dongfang, Hainan.
soldier: Head deep yellow, the abdomen pale yellow or greyish white with a slight reddish tinge. Pilosity of the head sparse, that of the abdomen denser. Head oval, the lateral margins arcuate, the widest point mostly at the middle of the head. Postmentum markedly projecting towards the ventral surface, its surface curved, the posterior end broader than the anterior end. Mandibles rather slender, gently curved, only the anterior end slightly bent; the left marginal tooth at one-third of the anterior part, sharp, its apex directed obliquely forwards; the right mandible with a very small and inconspicuous granular tooth slightly behind the corresponding position. The lateral margins of the labrum are curved and bear long setae, the labral apex narrow. Antennae with 15–16 segments; segment 2 longer than segments 3 and 4; in individuals with 15 segments segment 3 is shorter than segment 4, whereas in those with 16 segments segment 3 is longer than segment 4; the segments enlarge progressively after the fifth. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum have a median notch.
worker: Two forms, large and small. In the large form the head is deep yellow and the abdomen greyish white; the head is nearly square, the lateral margins slightly straight, the anterior end expanded and forming the widest part of the head; the fontanelle lies in the middle of the vertex and is a small circular pit; the postclypeus is raised and divided into right and left halves by a median longitudinal suture; antennae with 17 segments; the anterior part of the pronotum markedly upturned; body length 4.33–4.72 mm. In the small form the head is pale yellow and the abdomen greyish white; the lateral and posterior margins of the head form a continuous arc and are not square; antennae with 15–16 segments; body length 3.9–4 mm.
